$comment: Golden-task set for the claude-harness scaffold's own invariants. Consumed by eval/run-eval.mjs (npm run eval). Hamel L1 = does the structure hold; L2 = does a real scaffold install produce the expected tree. Additive: add tasks, never weaken existing assertions.

level1_invariants.desc: The bundled payload ships exactly 18 skills (one SKILL.md each).
Every bundled skill SKILL.md starts with YAML frontmatter (---).
The bundled payload ships at least 6 lifecycle hook scripts.
Every bundled hook script begins with a bash shebang.
The bundled payload ships at least 1 context-aware rule.
The bundled payload ships at least 1 sub-agent definition.
This repo's own .claude/agents/ is FLAT (no .claude/agents/agents/ double-nest from the forge bug).
An llms.txt agent-readable docs map exists at the repo root.
An AGENTS.md (cross-harness agent instructions) exists at the repo root.
identity/SOUL.md is a real identity, not an unfilled {{AGENT_NAME}} template.
No identity/*.md file contains an unfilled {{...}} placeholder.

level2_scaffold_goldens.desc: Installing the expert tier into a clean dir yields the full harness: 18 skills, >=6 hooks, all bundled rules, settings.local.json, memory/, resources/. Every hook script its settings name exists and is executable.

Installing the pro tier yields 5 skills, 6 hooks, memory/ and both scripts, and every hook script its settings name exists and is executable (the pro settings once named two scripts the installer never copied).
Installing the starter tier yields a minimal harness: 2 skills, 2 hooks, no memory/. Every hook script its settings name exists and is executable.

level3_surfaces.desc: init with --name, --language, --tier and --type installs the pro tier with no prompt and logs one scaffold-install line.
init rejects an unknown tier, and refuses to overwrite an existing harness without --force when no one can answer a prompt.
The MCP server lists exactly its three tools.
scaffold_plan over MCP reports the same skill counts as install() for all three tiers.
The session-start hook (the plugin's hook) finishes with exit 0 in a folder that is not a git repository.
The inline blockers an install writes really block: given the hook event on stdin, the Bash blocker stops rm -rf / and allows ls, and the pro file blocker stops a write to .env.
The three skills written for claude-harness have frontmatter and When to Use, Steps, Example and Output sections.
plugin.json, marketplace.json and hooks/hooks.json parse, and every agent and hook script they name exists.
memory-search answers a plain question from the docs.
